newsitem.title: ANGOLA: S.African officials visit ex-spy in Angolan jail.
newsitem.headline: S.African officials visit ex-spy in Angolan jail.

text.p: South African diplomats in Angola were briefly allowed to visit apartheid-era spy Craig Williamson in jail on Friday but said they were not allowed to speak to him.

Williamson, named in a South African court last month as having been behind the 1986 assassination of Swedish Prime Minister Olaf Palme, was detained last week at the Luanda hotel where he was staying while on business.
The Angolan government has not commented on his arrest.

"We were allowed consular access to Williamson. We managed to see him very briefly, but were not allowed to speak to him," a South African embassy official said. "He appeared in good health and gave us the thumbs-up sign at the end."
He said the embassy had not been told what the charges were against Williamson.
Williamson, who has denied any link to the Palme killing, is a partner in a company which supplies food and equipment to firms operating mainly in the diamond-rich Lunda Norte province.
